project:
  name: plant_disease_detection_deep_learning
  paper: Using Deep Learning for Image-Based Plant Disease Detection
  paper_title_full: "Using Deep Learning for Image-Based Plant Disease Detection"
  framework: PyTorch
  framework_version: ">=1.10"
  task: image_classification
  description: "基于深度卷积神经网络（AlexNet / GoogLeNet）的图像型植物病害检测（38 类作物-病害组合分类）"

version_selector:
  config_key: dataset_version
  values:
    - color
    - grayscale
    - segmented
  default: color
  note: "通过 config.yaml 的 dataset_version 字段切换预处理版本"

split_strategy:
  method: leaf_based_split
  train_test_splits:
    - 0.8
    - 0.6
    - 0.5
    - 0.4
    - 0.2
  default_train_ratio: 0.8
  seed: 42
  shuffle: true
  stratified: false
  leaf_mapping_constraint: "同一片叶子的多张图片必须保持在同一个集合中（all images of the same leaf go either in the training set or the testing set）"
  leaf_mapping_available: true
  leaf_mapping_coverage:
    mapped_images: 41112
    total_images: 54306
    note: "mappings available for 41,112 out of 54,306 images"
  val_split_ratio: 0.2
  val_split_source: from_train_set
  val_split_note: "FR-03 工程偏离（engineering deviation from paper）：论文仅使用 train/test 二路划分，无独立验证集；为支持 early stopping 与最优模型选择，从训练集中按 80/20 二次划分验证集"
  strict_mode_no_val: true

reproduction_mode: engineering
reproduction_modes_available:
  - engineering
  - strict
reproduction_mode_notes:
  engineering: "train -> val -> best -> test：从训练集划分验证集、每 epoch 验证、按 val_accuracy 选择最优模型"
  strict: "train -> 训练结束 -> test：不划分验证集、不做验证、只保存最终模型"

model:
  architectures:
    - alexnet
    - googlenet
  default: googlenet
  num_classes: 38
  input_size:
    - 3
    - 256
    - 256
  dropout_ratio: 0.5
  weight_init: kaiming_normal
  weight_init_note: "scratch 模式使用 kaiming_normal 初始化；transfer 模式使用 ImageNet 预训练权重"
  alexnet:
    framework_name: torchvision.models.alexnet
    classifier_reset_layer: classifier.6
    in_features: 4096
    out_features: 38
    aux_classifiers: []
  googlenet:
    framework_name: torchvision.models.googlenet
    aux_logits: true
    classifier_reset_layer: fc
    in_features: 1024
    out_features: 38
    aux_classifiers:
      - aux1.fc2
      - aux2.fc2

training_modes:
  scratch:
    description: "从头训练：所有层随机初始化"
    pretrained: false
    weight_init: kaiming_normal
    reset_layers: []
    freeze_backbone: false
  transfer:
    description: "迁移学习：加载 ImageNet 预训练权重，重置最后一层"
    pretrained: true
    pretrained_source: torchvision.models (ImageNet)
    reset_layers:
      - "classifier.6 (fc8, in_features=4096, out_features=38)"
      - "fc (主分类器, out_features=38)"
      - "aux1.fc2 (辅助分类器1, out_features=38)"
      - "aux2.fc2 (辅助分类器2, out_features=38)"
    freeze_backbone:
      value: false
      decision_type: engineering_decision
      engineering_default: false
      note: "此项为纯工程决策（论文未提及），默认不冻结（全量微调），因为目标域与 ImageNet 差异较大；可选策略 (a) 不冻结 fine-tuning，(b) 冻结 backbone 只训练重置的分类层"
    note: "论文报告的对比结果仅供对照，最终结论必须由代码从实际评估结果动态计算，禁止在报告/注释中写死结论性措辞"

training:
  training_mode: transfer
  batch_size_per_model:
    googlenet: 24
    alexnet: 100
  batch_size: 24
  batch_size_note: "论文显式指定 batch_size：GoogLeNet 24，AlexNet 100；实际运行以 batch_size_per_model 为准"
  epochs: 30
  image_size: 256
  loss_function:
    name: cross_entropy
    variant: softmax_cross_entropy
    label_smoothing: 0.0
    note: "inferred from softmax layer"
  optimizer:
    name: SGD
    full_name: Stochastic Gradient Descent
    lr: 0.005
    momentum: 0.9
    weight_decay: 0.0005
    nesterov: false
  scheduler:
    name: StepLR
    step_size: 10
    gamma: 0.1
    note: "每 10 个 epoch 将学习率乘以 0.1；PyTorch StepLR 与此行为等价"
  early_stopping:
    enabled: false
    patience: null
    monitor: val_accuracy
    note: "论文未使用 early stopping（NOT_FOUND），默认关闭"
  val_interval_epochs: 1
  grad_clip: null
  amp: false

checkpoint:
  save_best: true
  best_metric: val_accuracy
  best_mode: max
  save_final: true
  save_frequency_epochs: null
  save_optimizer_state: true
  resume_from: null
  dir: outputs/checkpoints
  filename_template: "{model}_{training_mode}_{dataset_version}_{train_ratio}.pth"
  note: "论文无独立验证集，best_metric 设为 val_accuracy 是工程偏离。严格复现论文时应从训练集二次划分验证集，或直接用 test_accuracy（不推荐，会导致数据泄露）"

inference:
